svg.title: and raise to the fourth power. The local witness-reach estimate places each witness j in the five- radius dome, so it belongs to K. The discarded set X therefore satisfies t|X| ≤HρZ. This count takes place on the original fine lattice and introduces no factor L4. Let Mij ≥0 be the previously bounded shortening majorant, with both row and column sums at most C. Its support-reach estimate shows that, for i ∈X, every contributing j /∈K has rj ≤t. Hence ∥ui∥≤Ct + X j∈K Mijrj, X i∈X ∥ui∥≤C(Hρ + 1)Z.
